g.text: Ranks are within one instrument; tied records share the average rank. 5 records that coincide exactly are spread side by side, up to ±0.62 rank (left) and ±1 percentage point (right) from their true x, so those x positions are offsets, not scores; a

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: hairline joins each spread group and a tick marks its true rubric10 value (rank 5; 98%). Labelled: records whose two ranks differ by at least 4 places (a display rule, not a test).

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: Record pairs (276): 218 ordered the same way by both instruments, 10 oppositely, 48 tied on at least one. Between projects (216 pairs): 193 same, 2 opposite, 21 tied; within a project (60 pairs): 25 same, 8 opposite, 27 tied. Spearman ρ within

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: project (n = 6 each): AI-READI undefined (rubric10 gives all 6 records the same score); CHORUS 0.81; CM4AI 0.69; VOICE 0.00.

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: No p-value: the 24 records are 8 project × prompt cells of 3 generation replicates, not independent draws, so the overall ρ mixes agreement between projects with agreement between replicates of one project. The Q19 flag (semantic_review.json)

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: qualifies the rubric20 total; the review assigned no replacement score and does not certify unflagged ratings.

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: Caveat: the instruments measure different constructs, so concordance is not validity against dataset truth, and disagreement alone does not show that either rubric is defective.
